value.rationale: The unique (11,5,2) Hadamard biplane is a canonical small symmetric design. A complete integral Rips barcode with a nontrivial 21-sphere stage, and a genuinely new cyclic 21-dimensional homology character, distinguishes biplane incidence geometry from lambda-one projective planes. Exact homotopy and symmetry for this recognized object are meaningful finite invariants without an alleged broader theorem.
